items.title: Cameroon got blown out by Guinea (who has some former NBA players). Yves Missi turned in another double-double with 11 points, 10 rebounds and 2 blocks.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Cameroon got blown out by Guinea (who has some former NBA players). Yves Missi turned in another double-double with 11 points, 10 rebounds and 2 blocks.

Sekou Doumouya led the way for Guinea with 18/6/3, 1 steal.

items.title: Yves Missi led Cameroon over Nigeria today: 24 points on 9-for-13 FG, 6-for-8 FT, 9 rebounds, 2 steals, 4 blocks.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Yves Missi led Cameroon over Nigeria today: 24 points on 9-for-13 FG, 6-for-8 FT, 9 rebounds, 2 steals, 4 blocks.

Josh Okogie had an off-shooting game for Nigeria: 7 points on 1-for-11 FG, 10 rebounds, 6 assists, 2 steals.
